 LAINEY WILSON UNVEILS NEW SONG “JUST A WOMAN,” TO DEBUT LIVE DURING TONIGHT’S CMA AWARDS
 Nov 18, 2026 
 LAINEY WILSON UNVEILS NEW SONG “JUST A WOMAN,” TO DEBUT LIVE DURING TONIGHT’S CMA AWARDS 
 RETURNS AS HOST OF THE CMA AWARDS FOR THE THIRD TIME + NOMINATED FOR THREE AWARDS
 NOMINATED FOR FIVE AWARDS AT 69TH GRAMMY AWARDS
 single artwork – download here 
 Multi-platinum global superstar Lainey Wilson ’s new song, “ Just A Woman ,” is out now via BBR Music Group / BMG Nashville . Listen/share HERE . Wilson will perform the song live for the first time during tonight’s 60th Annual CMA Awards , airing at 8:00pm ET on ABC and Disney+. 
 Written by Wilson, Luke Dick and Shane McAnally , the powerful ballad introduces a new chapter for Wilson, as she explores the complicated nuances of a relationship with her distinct blend of strength and vulnerability. 
 In addition to the performance, Wilson returns as host of the CMA Awards for the third time tonight, making her the first female to host solo for multiple years. Wilson is also nominated in three categories this year— Entertainer of the Year , Female Vocalist of the Year and Single of the Year (“Somewhere Over Laredo”)—and recently received the CMA International Artist Achievement Award . 
 Earlier this week, Wilson earned five nominations at the upcoming 69th Annual Grammy Awards : Best Country Song (“Phone, Keys, Wallet”), Best Country Solo Performance (“Can’t Sit Still”), Best Country Duo/Group Performance (“Phone, Keys, Wallet” with John Mayer + “Light of a Clear Blue Morning” with Dolly Parton, Miley Cyrus, Queen Latifah and Reba McEntire) and Best Contemporary Christian Music Performance/Song (“The Jesus I Know Now” with Brandon Lake).
